narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='c1'/>Ninety four times eleven is nine one three four. Nine plus four is thirteen, so thirteen goes in the middle.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Thirteen is not one digit, so its one must carry into the next place.
<bookmark mark='c3'/>Nine one three four is far too big, since ninety four times ten is only nine hundred forty.

narration: <bookmark mark='k1'/>To check, multiply by ten and add the number once more.
<bookmark mark='k2'/>Nine hundred forty plus ninety four is one thousand thirty four, which matches.
<bookmark mark='k3'/>Check the other three the same way, line by line.
